name: frappe-syntax-print
description: Use when creating print formats or generating PDFs in Frappe v14-v16. Covers Jinja print formats, Print Designer [v15+], Letter Head, PDF generation API (get_pdf, download_pdf), Report print formats ({%= %} syntax), page breaks, and print CSS patterns. Prevents common mistakes with template engine confusion and PDF rendering.
